title: Understanding the Energy Consumption of HPC Scale Artificial Intelligence
reasoning: The paper's core motivation stems from the ethical imperative to address climate change by understanding and mitigating the energy consumption and carbon emissions of AI, especially Deep Learning, on HPC platforms. This ethical concern for environmental responsibility is central to the paper's purpose, as stated in the abstract: 'it is therefore important to monitor the energy consumption of DL, to master its energy demand and attenuate its contribution to climate change.'
